title: A failed gate opens the handover
text: Each line is a gate. If a gate fails, fix it. If I can't fix it, the handover opens with that gate's name and what's still broken. A failed gate is never handed over quietly, and lack of time is not a reason to skip one.

source.heading: Before you cut (read this every time, before any HKS draft)

confirm: Which gates failed, and does the handover open with each one's name and what is still broken?
